lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play), while Atlanta Falcons owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#17 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Atlanta Falcons +0.8 with a fair total of 45.8 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Atlanta Falcons pass offence vs Chicago Bears pass defence, which sits −0.113 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Chicago Bears and Atlanta Falcons have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
